original_ai_output.title_zh: 高原州暴力事件：枪手在贝罗姆社区杀害四名治安志愿者，团体要求伸张正义
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 据称，枪手在尼日利亚高原州巴尔金拉迪地方政府区多罗瓦巴布杰的舒鲁姆村杀害了四名守护社区的治安志愿者，袭击发生在10月16日深夜。贝罗姆青年组织BYM谴责此次袭击，并称疑似匪徒和恐怖团伙发动了袭击。该组织还谴责10月16日在采矿点杀害两名贝罗姆青年的行为，并将其归咎于其所称的激进富拉尼民兵。上述信息目前仅来自单一来源，尚未获得独立证实。

location.raw_text: Shurum village, Dorowa Babuje, Barkin Ladi Local Government Area of Plateau State

key_facts.fact: 据称枪手在舒鲁姆村杀害四名治安志愿者
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Gunmen have reportedly killed four vigilantes keeping watch over their community in Shurum village, Dorowa Babuje, Barkin Ladi Local Government Area of Plateau State

key_facts.fact: 袭击据称发生在10月16日约23时56分
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The attack in Shurum reportedly occurred at about 11:56pm on October 16

key_facts.fact: 贝罗姆青年组织称疑似匪徒和恐怖团伙发动袭击
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Gyang reported that suspected bandits and terrorist gangs attacked the community and killed four people

key_facts.fact: 该组织谴责10月16日在采矿点杀害两名贝罗姆青年
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: condemned the killing of two young Berom men at a mining site in Burdinga, Gashish District, Barkin Ladi Local Government Area, on October 16, 2026

key_facts.fact: 该组织将采矿点杀戮归咎于其所称的激进富拉尼民兵
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: blamed what it described as Radical Islamic Fulani Militias for the killings

key_facts.fact: 该组织呼吁调查、逮捕和起诉责任人
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: called on the Plateau State Government and relevant security agencies to urgently investigate the reported killings, arrest the suspects and ensure that anyone found culpable is prosecuted

uncertainties: 袭击及死亡人数目前仅来自单一来源（Sahara Reporters 引述BYM警报），尚未获得独立证实
袭击者身份为疑似匪徒和恐怖团伙，尚未确认
采矿点两名青年被杀及10月13日Pam Dachung Kim被绑架杀害的指控均来自BYM单方说法，未获独立核实
